about:
CED Springville operates in Springville, Utah, as a branch of CED, one of the largest electrical solutions distributors in the United States with over 700 locations nationwide. The company supplies electrical equipment and related services to contractors and end users across multiple sectors.

The branch stocks a broad range of electrical products anchored by Schneider Electric and its flagship Square D line, including circuit breakers, panelboards, load centers, safety switches, and surge protection. In addition to product distribution, CED Springville provides switchgear quotations, project management, lighting quotations, lighting design packages, and delivery service. The facility maintains a large inventory to support quick turnaround on orders.

Its customer base includes residential electrical contractors, commercial electrical contractors, multifamily construction firms, and hybrid mixed-use projects, as well as industrial and solar installations. The company emphasizes local expertise backed by national inventory access.

CED Springville states that service, integrity, and reliability are at the core of its operations, differentiating itself through dedicated team support, competitive pricing, and a commitment to accessibility for individuals with disabilities.
